text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a short playbook for how v2 routes roll forward and what stays on v1. focus: chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool-calling, structured output. can we align launch criteria and a realistic deprecation window?

sam: Agree. My take: v2 must be non-breaking for existing chat flows, optional for advanced structured output. launch criteria = feature parity for common params + perf target within 10% of v1 P95 latency.

liam: For embeddings and rerank, cost profile and vector stability matter. We should require embeddings v2 to produce bitwise-compatible vectors or provide a migration mapping. if not, customers lose search ranking.

maya: +1 on vector stability. If we can't guarantee bitwise identical, we need an automated diff tool in the migration guide that highlights embedding drift and suggests remapping steps.

arjun: On infra side: canary routing for v2 with traffic split + auto-fallback to v1 on errors. we can do region-level rollout over 2 weeks. need a feature flag to force v1 for specific orgs.

zoe: Customer asks: shorter deprecation for experimental endpoints, longer for core chat. proposal: 6 months for embeddings/rerank/tooling, 12 months for chat/completions. docs + migration scripts must land before deprecation notice.

sam: Implementation notes: tool/function calling has semantic changes (new schema for tool metadata). we should support both schemas for a transition period via request header: `X-Route-Version: v2` or fallback. no silent behavior changes.

liam: Also we need tests: eval suites that run on v1 and v2 for sample prompts (including tool-calls). fail if structured output schema differs beyond tolerated leeway. tie this to CI gating for v2 rollouts.

maya: Launch checklist draft: 1) API contract doc + examples; 2) migration guide + diff tool for embeddings; 3) client SDKs updated with opt-in header; 4) canary + observability (latency, error, quality); 5) rollback plan and org-level flags; 6) docs page with timelines.

arjun: Observability additions: token-level cost delta, model-quality metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-cosine distribution), and tool-call success/failure rates. wire these into console per-route dashboard.

zoe: Prioritization ask from sales: support major SaaS customers' custom rerankers. recommend we treat rerank compatibility as high priority if they commit to dedicated capacity.

sam: Scope negotiation for v2 structured output: do we require strict JSON schema enforcement on the route or allow soft schema warnings? my vote: soft warnings initially, then strict enforcement after 6 months.

liam: Soft warnings + a `strict_schema=true` query param for customers who want enforcement. Also add a `schema_diff` report in the migration tooling.

maya: Deprecation message cadence: 1) beta opt-in (now), 2) general availability (GA) + migration docs (T), 3) 6-week reminder, 4) 2-week reminder, 5) sunset. Need legal + support sign-off before sending notices.

arjun: For rollback: a fast path is to flip routing at the gateway; longer-term fallback is a compatibility shim that translates v2 requests to v1 when feasible. shims are costly; prefer gateway flip.

zoe: Decide on timelines by Friday: pick default windows (can be shortened per-customer). sales to draft customer-specific commits for exceptions.

sam: Action items: - eng to define header-based opt-in for v2 and fallback rules (sam) - ml to produce embedding drift checker and threshold (liam) - infra to implement canary + org flag (arjun) - docs to draft migration guide and deprecation cadence (maya/zoe)

maya: Thanks. I'll assemble the playbook and circulate a short MD with the launch checklist and timeline. please add bullets to that doc with exact thresholds (latency delta, embedding cosine thresholds, schema mismatch tolerance).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: v2-chat route -> 3% traffic -> region us-west-2 at 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z. monitor window 48h. :rocket:

zoe: Perfect. if we can get the embedding checker by Wed we can include it in the GA checklist.

liam: I'll drop an initial notebook and thresholds into the shared drive by Tue EOD.

maya: Great — meeting adjourned. I'll post the MD in #product and @here when it's ready. :heavy_check_mark:
